briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.1%), not the risk-on confirmation needed to deploy new capital. With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we're holding rather than forcing buys on a neutral day, consistent with past lessons that patience on neutral days beats chasing deployment for its own sake. Existing positions are left to run; stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle exits automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' or neutral market day is when investors hold back from aggressive new bets because there's no clear signal that stocks are about to rally. Even if cash is available, buying just to 'put money to work' on a weak signal often leads to worse entries than waiting for genuine momentum to confirm. Patience during these quiet stretches protects capital for when a real opportunity appears.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」或中性市況是指投資者在沒有明確訊號顯示股市將上升時，不願意貿然加大注碼。即使手頭有現金，單純為了「用盡資金」而在訊號疲弱時買入，往往會換來較差的進場價位。在這些淡靜時期保持耐性，才能在真正機會出現時把資金用在最合適的地方。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no major catalyst, as NASDAQ slipped 0.4% and the S&P 500 eased 0.1% in a quiet, low-conviction session. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading volume and momentum signals were mixed across the screened candidates. This kind of directionless chop is common between major data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市輕微下滑，缺乏明顯催化因素，納斯達克指數跌0.4%，標普500指數跌0.1%，整體走勢淡靜、方向不明確。由於沒有明確的risk-on或risk-off訊號，篩選名單中的動能指標也呈現好壞參半的局面。這種橫行格局在重大數據或業績公布之間頗為常見。
